source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Flash System ROM to the same version with AMI flash tool for uEFI.
1. Send command: afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME
2. Reboot the system
3. Check version in BIOS setup menu and OS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BIOS should be flashed without errors
2. Version should be shown correctly in BIOS and OS

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Read-only BIOS Information output; does not perform a downgrade.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but substitutes a post-check for the flash and ignores the action/tool conflict.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; records downgrade-versus-reflash conflict and adds artifact, flag, console and recovery controls.

original_test_intent: The item/script claim an AFULnx downgrade, whereas the Procedure specifies an AFUEFI same-version reflash; an owner must resolve the intended tool, direction and target before any BIOS write.
original_method: Preserve the conflicting facts, validate the owner-selected tool/image/direction, anti-rollback and region compatibility, establish console/stable power/OOB recovery, then capture a supervised write, reboot and BIOS Setup plus OS evidence.
manual_activity: An engineer must resolve the source conflict, supervise the destructive console write and observe BIOS Setup. Agent artifact validation and OS/BMC evidence cannot replace those core decisions and visual acceptance.
required_inputs: Owner ruling on AFULnx downgrade versus AFUEFI same-version reflash
Exact board, current/target BIOS/ME and signed tool/image
EFI/Linux console path and stable AC
Recovery image/procedure, configuration baseline and OOB access
safety_requirements: Do not infer downgrade from the item or same-version reflash from Procedure; require an explicit ruling.
Never use dmidecode as evidence that the write occurred.
Validate anti-rollback and BIOS/ME/boot/NVRAM/security compatibility for any downgrade.
No interruption, automatic retry, tool/image/flag substitution or blind recovery.
Verify BIOS Setup, OS, ME, boot/security and settings after activation.
agent_execution_scope: Present the conflict and validate the approved selection, hashes, compatibility, power and recovery.
Stage and capture the supervised flash, reboot, OS/BMC and BIOS-screen evidence.
Prepare Tool Result without resolving source facts or issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Decide/document the intended tool/action/target and approve/supervise the write.
Observe BIOS Setup and direct recovery if required.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The dmidecode query is only an incomplete post-check and cannot perform or prove the source write.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not create a replacement command until the owner resolves AFULnx downgrade versus shown AFUEFI reflash; preserve both source facts.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Item, same-version wording, AFUEFI command/flags, reboot, dual-location checks, script and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After resolution, use signed artifacts, explicit downgrade/anti-rollback or reflash policy, full write proof, controlled activation and human-confirmed BIOS Setup plus OS health.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record selected tool/image hashes, board revision, current/target BIOS/ME, BMC and environment.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform/AMI documentation for the selected workflow and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds decision provenance and compatibility/recovery gates without silently rewriting the source.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong direction/tool can brick the board or validate the wrong behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may explicitly choose a supported downgrade or same-version reflash, but must document the override and cannot claim both interpretations.
expected_evidence: Owner ruling, board/current/target identities, signed tool/image and compatibility evidence
Anti-rollback/region policy, stable power and recovery approval
Exact approved command and complete flash output/status
Reboot health, OS version and engineer-confirmed BIOS Setup version/settings

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `AFULnx: downgrade` and its script path contradict the same-version AFUEFI Procedure and `afuefix64.efi` command. This materially changes tool and coverage and is not auto-resolved.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete and the owner decision is recorded; execution alone is unready. The library case is not permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects read-only substitution and restores the BIOS-write scope.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its conflict and downgrade-specific safety analysis, with MANUAL ONLY for console/BIOS Setup acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates case-specific decision, readiness, agent evidence and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an OS version read from masquerading as a downgrade and prevents silent choice between incompatible tool/direction definitions.
independent_technical_reasoning: A downgrade requires anti-rollback and compatibility evidence that a reflash does not. The conflict is therefore substantive; whichever action is selected still requires supervised console write and BIOS Setup observation.
